name: review-scout
description: Mine user reviews (mobile app store, browser extension, web/SaaS) into ranked findings: reproducible bugs, feature-request clusters, cross-version regressions, praise worth keeping. Fetches from two sources only: Apple's public customer-reviews RSS feed and Google's Play Developer API (your own app, with a service account). For browser extensions and web/SaaS products it fetches nothing and prints how to export your own reviews.
